reason: In src/sentry/spans/consumers/process/flusher.py:53,105, SpanFlusher spawns workers via multiprocessing.get_context("spawn").Process, which produces multiprocessing.context.SpawnProcess instances (a sibling of multiprocessing.context.Process under BaseProcess, not a subclass). Consequently, the isinstance(process, multiprocessing.Process) guard in _ensure_processes_alive at src/sentry/spans/consumers/process/flusher.py:254-255 always evaluates to False, so hung or unhealthy processes are never killed before _create_process_for_shards starts replacements at line 259.
